title: Hunts FH-039: Handle refunds, disputes and consumption

source.ref: Frequency Hunts Build Plan (9 Nov 2026), Tier 4, Entitlement. Owner asked 2026-11-09 to build the program into the site.

detail: Serialize entitlement validation with consumption and revocation. Map partial refunds to explicit units. Done when: Old paid event cannot reopen refunded benefit. Ambiguous partial refund enters review, and consumed service does not free stock. Requires: FH-037. Owner role: Billing and security.
